title: A much better History
summary: Jellydash can now import Playback Reporting data, browse beyond the first 100 plays, and show Jellyfin profile pictures.
highlights: Import existing plays from a Playback Reporting TSV backup, SQLite database, or the installed plugin API.
Browse older plays with pagination instead of stopping at the first 100.
See Jellyfin profile pictures in Now Playing, History, and Statistics, with initials when no image is available.
Find the importer anytime from History or Settings. It never opens another popup on its own.
